description.value: Sip Song Thai Cuisine is a Thai restaurant on West 16th Avenue in Vancouver's Dunbar-Southlands neighbourhood, offering both dine-in with reservations and online ordering for pickup or delivery. The restaurant operates with Square-powered checkout and emphasizes personalized service from front-of-house to kitchen. Touring cyclists navigating the quieter residential streets of the west side will find a sit-down Thai meal option with the convenience of online pre-ordering.
